output.summary: The zero-deviation record is most likely an artifact of the February 2026 bonus penalty, which docks supervisors for each deviation report. Reporting stopped while independent measures worsened: customer complaints, QC lot rejections, replacement-material purchases and survey fear of speaking up. Line 3's 118% attainment is explained by unrecorded lending of Line 1 and 4 technicians; per-technician-hour output is flat. It also fits the alleged undocumented rework, and most complaints are luer-bond leaks traced to Line 3 lots. Tubing supplier and training do not fit the timing or the data. Whether the Plant Manager directs the lending is unproven. Do not scale Line 3 or discipline anyone yet. Suspend the penalty and commission an independent investigation, then confirm the rework through device history and material records.
